title: Polari Forge
description: The self-hosted forge (Forgejo): git hosting that mirrors the forest, and the Debian package registry that replaces the reprepro apt route. The project is the capability, never the content - repos, packages, database and keys live in the named volume.

volumes.name: forge-data
volumes.holds: repositories, packages, sqlite database, sessions, ssh host keys, the registry signing key, app.ini

notes: Not wired into pol prod profiles yet (frg-2/frg-3). The image is rootful: it starts as root and drops to USER_UID under s6, which uses the docker-default SETUID/SETGID/CHOWN - capabilities [] means none ADDED beyond docker-default.
